paragraphs.text: Mira Vale shared her love of gardening by keeping spare seeds by the garden gate. She helped beginners choose sunny patches and showed them how to water seedlings gently. At seed-sharing mornings, she made room for new volunteers without making them feel small.

On rainy afternoons, Mira brought tea to the garden shed and listened to others without rushing their conversations. She believed that "useful things deserved another chance," once spending an afternoon repairing a bent watering can.
